# Daily Report — 2026-10-22

## Task Completed
Added import set management tools (`list_import_sets`, `get_import_set`, `cleanup_import_set`) targeting the `sys_import_set` table. Import sets are staging collections created when a data source is loaded; each import set groups the raw rows that will be processed by a transform map. `list_import_sets` supports filters for label, table_name, state, and data_source with full pagination. `get_import_set` resolves by sys_id or exact label with 404/empty-result guards. `cleanup_import_set` deletes an import set to free storage, with 404 guard. All three tools are registered in `system_administrator` and `full` packages.
